title: One hide path: cells stage their saves first, then the page's single flush runs, so no cell calls the store's flush
evidence: Done 2026-11-25 (root fix R21, option A; owner ruling: the entrypoint also hears pagehide): lib/page-hide.ts holds the one set of hide listeners (beforeunload, pagehide, hidden visibilitychange). HealthTool's stage and each open ValueCell's (sendLeave('hidden')) register with onPageHide; every stage runs in its own try, then one flushRoadmapStoreSync, then the entrypoint's after-hook (afterPageHide, hidden only), which standalone/page-departure.ts registers. No cell imports the flush. Pins: components/HealthTool.page-hide.test.tsx (R21 PR 1, unchanged by the move); lib/page-hide.test.ts; US-10 AC14. From PR 1695 (Codex R1).
